topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Finding out about the novel was a revelation, like turning a corner to find a familiar street bathed in a light I've never seen before. I had no idea my life, our life together, had been unfolding in the pages of his imagination as well. It's a strange sort of intimacy, to know that I've been a character in his secret thoughts, that the moments we've shared were so vivid, so compelling to him that he had to capture them. I want to read every word, to trace the story of our lives as he's seen it, to find the parts where our stories merge and diverge. It's more than a novel; it's another layer of our relationship, woven with the threads of his perspective and art.
